title: Subscription plan catalog
description: What the subscription page at #/subscribe is allowed to say, and nothing else. public/data/subscription-catalog.json is GENERATED by tools/gen-subscription-catalog.mjs from the engine's own entitlement model (src/lib/entitlement.js) -- the page that takes money is not allowed to know its own prices, so there is no hand-written copy to drift. THE RENDERER OWNS THIS SCHEMA; the generator owns the content. tools/check-data-schemas.mjs validates one against the other on every build, and src/subscription-catalog.js re-validates in the browser and fails closed: a catalog this schema would reject renders as a refusal with signup disabled, never as a partial plan list. One cross-field rule lives in that reader rather than here, because this validator cannot express it: every id in a plan's `grants` must name an entry in `capabilities`.

derivedFrom.description: The engine module every word of this file is derived from, named so a reader can check the derivation instead of trusting it.

unlicensedInstallStatement.description: What an install without a licence is, in the model's own words. Rendered whole: a pricing page that shows only the paid column implies the free product is a trial, which R1228/R1229 refuse.

neverGated.description: What is free forever and never licence-checked. Non-empty on purpose: the reader refuses a catalog that states what money buys and not what is free beside it.

capabilities.description: The closed table of everything a licence may gate, keyed by capability id. Plans may only include ids described here -- an inclusion line the model cannot describe is an inclusion the page cannot promise.

rationale.description: Why this costs money. A paid inclusion with no stated reason is a line item, not an explanation, and the page is not allowed to charge for one.

requiredTiers.description: The plan ids this capability belongs to. The generator refuses a model where a tier grants a capability whose requiredTiers does not admit that tier -- a contradiction inside the model must not be published as a plan card.

freeAlternatives.description: Non-empty on purpose (R1228): a gate that cannot name a free way to do the job is a hostage situation, so every gated capability states its alternatives and the page shows them.

qualifiedLabel.description: The label with the paid product's name in front of it, for surfaces where the bare label would read as gating the whole product.

monthlyUsd.description: Major units (dollars). null means the model prices this plan no way at all -- legal only for a free plan; the conditional below and the generator both refuse a paid plan without a real price, because a blank or guessed price on a subscription page is how a customer is charged something they were never shown.

annualUsd.description: null means no annual price is offered. It does NOT mean unknown.

productId.description: What the licensing service issues a licence against. Required for a paid plan (see the conditional): a payment that maps back to no tier is money taken for an entitlement nothing can issue.

grants.description: Capability ids from the top-level `capabilities` table. That containment is enforced by the generator and re-checked at load by src/subscription-catalog.js; this validator cannot see across fields.
